verification.note: The six Functions and all 22 Category identifiers and names were confirmed on 2026-10-20 against NIST's own documents (NIST CSWP 29, the CSF 2.0 Core table, and the NIST cyberframework FAQ) via search of nist.gov and nvlpubs.nist.gov. The 22-category count is settled; a secondary source claiming 23 was wrong. Still outstanding: the ~106 subcategory identifiers and their exact wording, which require reading CSWP 29 in full. Direct HTTP access to nist.gov remains blocked by the build environment's network policy.
